questions.prompt: What problem do Fortran 2008 `submodule`s solve in large multi-module codebases?

options.text: Separating procedure interfaces (`module`) from implementations (`submodule`) to eliminate cascading recompilation

questions.prompt: In Fortran OOP, what is the difference between `type(Shape)` and `class(Shape)`?

options.text: `type(Shape)` is monomorphic (exact static type); `class(Shape)` is polymorphic (can hold `Shape` or any `extends(Shape)` subtype)

questions.prompt: What does `select type (s => shape)` inside a polymorphic Fortran procedure do?

options.text: Safely narrows polymorphic `class(Shape)` to concrete subtypes (`type is (Circle)`) at runtime

Useful for freeing C FFI handles or external resources deterministically
Only run when the program exits

questions.prompt: Match each Fortran `iso_c_binding` feature to its purpose.

columns.label: Gives a Fortran procedure or struct C ABI linkage and symbol name
Obtains the C `type(c_ptr)` address of an interoperable `target`
Converts a raw `c_ptr` into a typed Fortran `pointer`

questions.prompt: Why must `type, bind(c) :: CConfig` only use `iso_c_binding` types (`integer(c_int)`, `real(c_double)`)?

options.text: To guarantee exact C struct memory layout and ABI compatibility across compilers

code.source:
use, intrinsic :: iso_c_binding
type, bind(c) :: CPoint
  real(c_double) :: x, y
end type CPoint

questions.prompt: When wrapping Fortran kernels for Python with `f2py`, why does NumPy need `order='F'` (column-major) for zero-copy arrays?

options.text: Fortran expects column-major `F_CONTIGUOUS` arrays; passing a C-order array forces `f2py` to copy/transpose it

questions.prompt: In OpenMP with Fortran (`!$omp parallel do`), what happens if a loop-local temporary variable `tmp` is NOT listed in `private(tmp)`?

options.text: All threads share one `tmp` variable, causing a data race and corrupted results
Compiler makes it thread-local automatically always

code.source:
!$omp parallel do default(none) shared(a,n) private(i) reduction(+:s)
do i = 1, n
  s = s + a(i)
end do

questions.prompt: What does `default(none)` in an OpenMP `!$omp parallel do` directive enforce?

options.text: Forces the programmer to explicitly classify every referenced variable as `shared`, `private`, or `reduction` at compile time

questions.prompt: How do Fortran Coarrays (`real :: grid(n)[*]`) model parallel execution?

options.text: Partitioned Global Address Space (PGAS) built into the Fortran standard: each image has local memory and accesses remote images via `[img]` cosubscripts

code.source:
real :: x[*]
x = real(this_image())
sync all

questions.prompt: What does `sync all` do in a Fortran coarray program?

options.text: Acts as a global barrier synchronizing all images and completing pending remote coarray reads/writes

questions.prompt: In MPI (`mpi_f08` module), why is non-blocking `MPI_Isend` / `MPI_Irecv` + `MPI_Waitall` preferred over blocking `MPI_Send` / `MPI_Recv` for neighbor halo exchange?

options.text: Prevents circular deadlock between neighboring ranks and allows overlapping communication with interior computation

questions.prompt: What is the key advantage of `use mpi_f08` over legacy `include 'mpif.h'` or `use mpi`?

options.text: Strong compile-time type checking on MPI handles (`type(MPI_Comm)`, `type(MPI_Request)`) and assumed-type buffers

questions.prompt: Select all effective techniques for maximizing single-node Fortran numerical performance. (Select all that apply.)

Use cache blocking (tiling) for large matrix/stencil kernels
Avoid `pointer` aliasing on hot arrays; mark assumed-shape inputs `contiguous`

questions.prompt: Why should `-ffast-math` (or `-Ofast`) be used with caution in scientific simulations?

options.text: It relaxes IEEE-754 rules (e.g., assuming no NaNs/Infs and reassociating floating-point ops), which can alter convergence or break `ieee_is_nan` checks

questions.prompt: What does `use, intrinsic :: ieee_arithmetic` provide?

options.text: Standardized checks and controls for `ieee_is_nan`, `ieee_is_finite`, rounding modes, and floating-point exception flags

questions.prompt: In GPU offloading with OpenMP Target (`!$omp target teams distribute parallel do`) or OpenACC, what is the biggest performance bottleneck to minimize?

options.text: Host-to-device and device-to-host PCIe/NVLink memory transfers—keep data resident on the GPU across timesteps (`!$omp target data`)

questions.prompt: What does `abstract interface` combined with `procedure(func_interface), pointer :: cb` enable?

questions.prompt: What does Amdahl's Law warn about when parallelizing a Fortran simulation?

options.text: The maximum speedup is bounded by the remaining sequential fraction `1 / (s + (1 - s)/P)`

questions.prompt: Why do production Fortran simulations prefer `HDF5` or `NetCDF` over plain ASCII text files for large 3D/4D arrays?

options.text: Binary self-describing formats (`HDF5`/`NetCDF`) support parallel MPI-IO, compression, metadata, and orders-of-magnitude faster I/O

questions.prompt: What is a common performance pitfall when using `type(Particle), allocatable :: p(:)` (Array of Structures) vs `type :: Particles; real, allocatable :: x(:), y(:), z(:)` (Structure of Arrays)?

options.text: AoS scatters `x` values with non-unit stride, hurting SIMD vectorization; SoA packs each field contiguously for unit-stride SIMD
SoA cannot be passed to subroutines
